  "scientific_object_assessment": "The scientific object is narrow and well-defined: whether changing only the learning projection (what the updater observes from an identical K=8 pool) changes future frozen skill. The contract explicitly disclaims novelty for CADP, success/failure contrast, first-divergence extraction, validation-gated editing, and broad failure-utility claims. The surviving object is a causal mechanism (serving-induced observation kernel), not a method or benchmark claim. This is appropriately scoped for a pre-execution contract.",
  "causal_identification_assessment": "The identical-pool cloned-state design is the strongest feature. All six arms share the same task, initial skill SHA, K=8 pool, served winner, actor, verifier, updater, batch, and evaluation probes; only the evidence packet differs. The updater qualification artifact confirms six isolated post-states with same acting scores and one add-record per task, and confirms winner/precommitted and winner/rejected-witness diverge on rescue streams. Provider stochasticity is addressed by freezing the resolved model identity (deepseek-v4-pro-ga-260813), disabling thinking, temperature 0, retry 0, and stopping the tranche on any resolved-id change. The precommitted rollout-0 arm is correctly framed as an alternative observation kernel, not a no-censoring oracle. The duplicated-winner arm controls token/context length, and the random-nonwinner arm controls generic diversity. The SkillCAT-style contrast is a matched control, not a full reproduction, and is correctly separated from the minimal Rejected-Witness intervention. The causal chain (best-of-K rescue -> winner-only projection removes failed witness -> weaker one-step frozen skill) is falsifiable via the projection-null and duplicated-winner-equivalence STOP gates.",
  "statistics_assessment": "The scientific unit is the independently evolved eight-task stream-state (n=12), not the rollout or probe, which correctly avoids pseudoreplication. The primary estimand is Delta_s = J_s(rejected_witness) - J_s(winner_only), summarized as mean Delta_s, with an exact one-sided 2^12 sign-flip test and 95% percentile bootstrap over streams. This is a valid nonparametric design for n=12 paired stream-level differences. The contract does not overclaim: it explicitly states E1 alone is insufficient for the paper-level claim, requiring Identification+Prediction+longitudinal Closure. The E1 support gate (at least 8 rescue task-packets and >=6 streams exposed, drop no stream, pass all or stop) is pre-outcome and non-selective. The n=12 is adequate for the E1 decision (a decisive projection-null test), not for a paper claim, and the contract says so.",
  "public_dataset_assessment": "SpreadsheetBench Verified-400 is correctly assigned a non-shopping role: it is a later public externality/longitudinal validation, entered only after the controlled-suite mechanism passes. SpreadsheetBench 2 is assigned a late workflow-level transfer role with an explicit entry condition and STOP discipline against opening it to rescue a negative Verified-400 result. The controlled suite is explicitly labeled not-public and not for external benchmark claims. The no-benchmark-shopping rules are explicit and pre-outcome. This is appropriate.",
  "baseline_assessment": "The mandatory controls are comprehensive and correctly targeted. Duplicated-winner addresses token/context-length reduction; random-nonwinner addresses generic diversity; precommitted rollout-0 addresses alternative fixed observation kernels; SkillCAT-style contrast addresses the strongest direct method reduction; winner-only is the tied acting/learning default. The longitudinal RethinkSkill feedback views (Normal/Fail-only/Success-only) are correctly separated as feedback-dynamics baselines that do not replace the exact-same-pool intervention. The closest-work reduction boundary is honest: SkillCAT, RethinkSkill, SkillOpt, and TopoCurate are all acknowledged as reducing the broader claims, leaving only the narrow serving-induced observation-kernel mechanism.",

  "e0_pilot_recommendation": "GO",
  "single_sentence_verdict": "The exact F0-R4 contract is sufficiently identifiable, falsifiable, and control-complete to authorize only the 12-task E0 pilot, with no blocking collisions and no overclaiming of the n=12 stream-level inference."

review.baseline_assessment: The mandatory controls are comprehensive and correctly targeted. Duplicated-winner addresses token/context-length reduction; random-nonwinner addresses generic diversity; precommitted rollout-0 addresses alternative fixed observation kernels; SkillCAT-style contrast addresses the strongest direct method reduction; winner-only is the tied acting/learning default. The longitudinal RethinkSkill feedback views (Normal/Fail-only/Success-only) are correctly separated as feedback-dynamics baselines that do not replace the exact-same-pool intervention. The closest-work reduction boundary is honest: SkillCAT, RethinkSkill, SkillOpt, and TopoCurate are all acknowledged as reducing the broader claims, leaving only the narrow serving-induced observation-kernel mechanism.
review.causal_identification_assessment: The identical-pool cloned-state design is the strongest feature. All six arms share the same task, initial skill SHA, K=8 pool, served winner, actor, verifier, updater, batch, and evaluation probes; only the evidence packet differs. The updater qualification artifact confirms six isolated post-states with same acting scores and one add-record per task, and confirms winner/precommitted and winner/rejected-witness diverge on rescue streams. Provider stochasticity is addressed by freezing the resolved model identity (deepseek-v4-pro-ga-260813), disabling thinking, temperature 0, retry 0, and stopping the tranche on any resolved-id change. The precommitted rollout-0 arm is correctly framed as an alternative observation kernel, not a no-censoring oracle. The duplicated-winner arm controls token/context length, and the random-nonwinner arm controls generic diversity. The SkillCAT-style contrast is a matched control, not a full reproduction, and is correctly separated from the minimal Rejected-Witness intervention. The causal chain (best-of-K rescue -> winner-only projection removes failed witness -> weaker one-step frozen skill) is falsifiable via the projection-null and duplicated-winner-equivalence STOP gates.
nonblocking_improvements: The E0 pilot stop condition ('zero rescue events or protocol failure') could be made more precise about what counts as a protocol failure, but this is a qualification gate, not a scientific claim, and the predeclared extension rule is acceptable.

The random-nonwinner arm uses a SHA-selected nonwinner; the contract could pre-specify whether the nonwinner is selected from failed or successful nonwinners, but the salt and determinism are already frozen, and this is a control, not the primary estimand.
The duplicated-winner arm controls token count but not semantic redundancy effects; however, the STOP gate on duplicated-winner equivalence directly addresses this, so it is not blocking.
review.public_dataset_assessment: SpreadsheetBench Verified-400 is correctly assigned a non-shopping role: it is a later public externality/longitudinal validation, entered only after the controlled-suite mechanism passes. SpreadsheetBench 2 is assigned a late workflow-level transfer role with an explicit entry condition and STOP discipline against opening it to rescue a negative Verified-400 result. The controlled suite is explicitly labeled not-public and not for external benchmark claims. The no-benchmark-shopping rules are explicit and pre-outcome. This is appropriate.
review.scientific_object_assessment: The scientific object is narrow and well-defined: whether changing only the learning projection (what the updater observes from an identical K=8 pool) changes future frozen skill. The contract explicitly disclaims novelty for CADP, success/failure contrast, first-divergence extraction, validation-gated editing, and broad failure-utility claims. The surviving object is a causal mechanism (serving-induced observation kernel), not a method or benchmark claim. This is appropriately scoped for a pre-execution contract.
review.single_sentence_verdict: The exact F0-R4 contract is sufficiently identifiable, falsifiable, and control-complete to authorize only the 12-task E0 pilot, with no blocking collisions and no overclaiming of the n=12 stream-level inference.
review.statistics_assessment: The scientific unit is the independently evolved eight-task stream-state (n=12), not the rollout or probe, which correctly avoids pseudoreplication. The primary estimand is Delta_s = J_s(rejected_witness) - J_s(winner_only), summarized as mean Delta_s, with an exact one-sided 2^12 sign-flip test and 95% percentile bootstrap over streams. This is a valid nonparametric design for n=12 paired stream-level differences. The contract does not overclaim: it explicitly states E1 alone is insufficient for the paper-level claim, requiring Identification+Prediction+longitudinal Closure. The E1 support gate (at least 8 rescue task-packets and >=6 streams exposed, drop no stream, pass all or stop) is pre-outcome and non-selective. The n=12 is adequate for the E1 decision (a decisive projection-null test), not for a paper claim, and the contract says so.
